innovation.text: The Ihsan App is designed to transform knowledge into action and bring faith alive in daily routines.
The team has identified a wide range of voluntary acts recommended in Islam and woven them into a unique digital experience.
The Ihsan App features GPS-enabled reminders and personalized alarms for acts like Tahajjud, Qiyam, Salatul Duha, and Dua for entering various locations.
The app delivers contextual notifications for dua and dhikr based on real-time moments, locations, or situations.
When events such as rain occur, the app sends a notification with a dua suggestion to guide users' thinking.
The app includes Tasbih tracking with analytics, turning remembrance into measurable progress and motivation.
The Ihsan App offers comprehensive guidance for all acts of worship, including virtues, benefits, and clear instructions on how to perform them.
The app features a habit-tracking system to help translate intention into action.
The Ihsan app is designed to remain useful over the long run by continuously providing Muslims with daily reminders, contextual duas, and acts of worship.
The content and functionality of the Ihsan app are evergreen, ensuring that development resources invested today continue to have an impact for years.
Core features and content modules of the Ihsan app can be adapted and repurposed across multiple contexts and campaigns.
Educational and spiritual resources shared on the Ihsan platform can be reused by users, multiplying impact without additional material costs.
As a digital product, Ihsan eliminates the need for physical materials, thereby reducing paper consumption, ink usage, and related waste.
The choice to deliver content digitally prioritizes data and cloud infrastructure over consumable, physical resources.

Distribution of the app has near-zero marginal environmental impact compared to shipping physical goods.
Updates and improvements for the app are delivered electronically, avoiding packaging, shipping, and manufacturing emissions.

Ihsan supports a lighter environmental footprint through its digital approach.
